conditioning: From-zero, matched saved random priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol; single registered factor change is region_id from F_b011_s030__reference to F_b011_s030__G06, holding operator=pointwise, controller=unit_rms, dose, window and target_schedule fixed. G06 is a source terminal node (single_b011_final_030) with 40 same-root controls and 0 same-graph controls; its local point moments are unweighted source local-point targets in actual_teacher_time_world_A at time 0.5, distinct from Gaussian whole-cloud discovery fields. The evidence clock domain is the complete learning_window [0.0,0.5], not the control window.
contrast_definition: From t=0 with matched saved random priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol; one registered intervention versus its parent. Chemical graphs remain free; historical suffix score levels are not from-zero treatment effects.
falsifier: If the G06 region-only run reproduces the parent's tail utility and mean within the paired descriptive spread while showing the same boundary-attainment/high-native-element-fraction pattern as the failed geometry-imitation rounds, the region-conditioned explanation is not supported and the failure is better attributed to the shared pointwise imitation mechanism.
observable_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.
predicted_execution_response: Measured current-program response only: expect nonzero active_updates comparable to the parent (40) with assignment_switch_fraction and point_rms_A reported per step; no terminal-affinity gradient is implied. If the region change is inert, response statistics should resemble the parent/response record; if it is active, point_rms_A and target_error_mean should differ from the parent values.
predicted_terminal_response: Unknown and not forecast from source scores. The source layout score for G06 is not a generated score forecast; the primary readout is the frozen tail utility U_tau with the affinity mean guard, compared against parent/outcomes (U_tau 0.01245729128519694, best_qualified_pic50 8.4340238571167, mean_all_pic50 7.827488899230957, n=24).
relationship_to_previous_failed_interven: Prior from-zero failures changed operator (local_moments R05, pocket_distance R07, point_band R12_v2/R14_v2), dose (R07_v2, R10_v2), target_schedule (R08_v2) or region (R03, R04, R09_v2, R11_v2, R13_v2) while keeping pointwise in most region trials. Those are heterogeneous interventions on a reused prior pool, not independent replicates, and no aggregate causal attribution is available. This proposal keeps the parent operator and changes only region to an untested node, so it distinguishes region-conditioning from operator-conditioning of the same imitation failure.
scientific_hypothesis: The repeated from-zero geometry-imitation failures (R03, R04, R05, R07, R07_v2, R08_v2, R09_v2, R10_v2, R11_v2, R12_v2, R13_v2, R14_v2) all lowered the tail versus the reference parent while several achieved high boundary attainment and high final native_element_fraction. That pattern is consistent with the pointwise operator matching a target cloud whose local geometry is attainable but whose terminal value is not improved by closer imitation. G06 is an untested region whose local point moments are measured directly on a source terminal node rather than inherited from the reference region, so a region-only change with the parent operator tests whether the failure is region-conditioned rather than operator-conditioned. This is a zero-generation functional response check, not proof of efficacy.
